sentences.text:
Respondents
 ------
Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
-----
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Ranjan Kumar Singh, Advocate

Mr. Ranjan Kumar Singh, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application to file an application under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 before the Competent Authority so that the matter be referred to the Land Acquisition Court for deciding fair and just compensation relating to acquisition of the land appertaining to Khata No. 3,
Plot No. 519, admeasuring 5 1/3 decimals, Mouza Harchanda.

Accordingly, this application is dismissed as withdrawn with a liberty to file an application before the Deputy Commissioner, Ranchi, respondent No. 2 under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894.
The learned Deputy Commissioner shall dispose of the aforesaid application within one month of the filing of the same.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Saurabh/-
